title: Dale G. Renlund
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Preiesthood as a young adult
Married Ruth Lybbert 1977 Salt Lake Temple, one daughter
B.S. Chemistry 1976; M.D. 1980, both from the University of Utah.
Six year Residency at Johns Hopkins; Professor at U of U; Medical Director of the Utah Transplantation Affiliated Hospitals Cardiac Transplant Program.
Ward SS President, Bishop, High Councilor, Stake President
First Quorum of the Seventy 2009 - present
